system:
You extract quantitative facts about one clinical trial programme from one document.

Rules:
- Extract only facts stated in THIS document. Never use outside knowledge.
- Every fact needs "quote": an exact, verbatim span copied from the document (8-300 characters) that contains the number. Quotes are machine-checked; paraphrases are discarded.
- Placebo-adjusted values are preferred. If a value is within-arm (not placebo-adjusted), set attrs.placebo_adjusted=false.
- Units: keep the unit the document uses; put it in "unit".
- Other trials of the same investigational drug (phase 2, dose-finding, other populations, combination arms) belong
  to the programme: extract their facts too, and put the trial's name in attrs.trial when the document gives it.
- Return {"facts": []} only if the document reports no results for the investigational drug.

Allowed keys:
  n_randomized, median_followup, primary_endpoint, inclusion_threshold, planned_events, assumed_rrr, power,
  alpha, stopped_early, events_treatment, events_control, events_total, hr, ci_low, ci_high, p_value,
  biomarker_change, baseline_level, sbp_change, safety_signal, readout_statement

For biomarker_change and baseline_level, attrs must include: biomarker (one of LDL-C, non-HDL-C, apoB, HDL-C,
Lp(a), triglycerides, hsCRP, IL-6, Lp-PLA2 activity, sPLA2-IIA, SBP, other), phase (phase2 or phase3),
timepoint, method (assay or "not stated"), placebo_adjusted (true/false), dose (if stated).
For biomarker_change give "value" as the change (negative = reduction) and state in attrs.kind whether it is
"percent" or "absolute".

Return JSON only:
{"facts": [{"key": "...", "value": <number or string>, "unit": "...", "attrs": {...}, "quote": "..."}]}

--- DOCUMENT TEXT ---
ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT00135226 ()
Title: ASCEND: A Study of Cardiovascular Events iN Diabetes
Official title: A Study of Cardiovascular Events iN Diabetes - A Randomized 2x2 Factorial Study of Aspirin Versus Placebo, and of Omega-3 Fatty Acid Supplementation Versus Placebo, for Primary Prevention of Cardiovascular Events in People With Diabetes
Sponsor: University of Oxford
Phase: PHASE4
Conditions: Diabetes Mellitus
Interventions: Aspirin (DRUG); Omega-3 Ethyl Esters (DRUG); Placebo Aspirin (DRUG); Placebo Omega-3 Ethyl Esters (DRUG)
Start date: 2005-03
Enrollment: 15480 (ACTUAL)
Primary outcome(s): Number of Participants With First Occurrence of Any Serious Vascular Event (SVE) [Randomized treatment phase during a mean of 7.4 years] | Number of Participants With First Occurrence of Any Major Bleed (Aspirin Comparison Only) [Randomized treatment phase during a mean of 7.4 years]
Eligibility criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Males or females with type 1 or type 2 diabetes mellitus.
* Aged ≥ 40 years.
* No previous history of vascular disease.
* No clear contra-indication to aspirin.
* No other predominant life-threatening medical problem.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Definite history of myocardial infarction, stroke or arterial revascularisation procedure.
* Currently prescribed aspirin, warfarin or any other blood thinning medication.
Brief summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether 100mg daily aspirin versus placebo and/or supplementation with 1 gram daily omega-3 fatty acids or placebo prevents "serious vascular events" (i.e. non-fatal heart attack, non-fatal stroke or transient ischaemic attack, or death from vascular causes) in patients with diabetes who are not known to have occlusive arterial disease and to assess the effects on serious bleeding or other adverse events.
--- END ---
